_comment: Six background treatments cut from the owner's atmospheric board (tiles are about 505x195 px on the board, so they are upscaled and softened; replace with the owner's original files when available). Regions are inset 4 px to stay clear of the tile border.

tiles.note: Luminous white base with a huge soft-focus pale-blue bloom from upper left.
Airy white with blurred lavender and blue light pooling at opposite corners.
Pale blue and mint translucent blurred ribbons with lots of negative space.
Distant blurred blue/lilac orbs behind empty white glass cards.
Extremely faint abstract line-chart silhouettes blurred in the far background.
Frosted white with blue edge glow and soft depth.
